paragraphs: The 730Ld and 740Ld long-wheelbase variants were part of the G11/G12-generation BMW 7 Series, produced from 2015 to 2022. Both variants use the B57 — a 3.0-litre inline-six diesel engine from BMW's modular B-series family. B57 engines are generally well-regarded for their reliability and refinement. The 730Ld/740Ld is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
